launcher_note: Original execution imported the unchanged run_evaluation function through a local observer that wrote snapshot checkpoints and collected reported model identifiers. The local launcher is not included in this publication. Equivalent uninstrumented CLI commands appear in README.md and cells; results and runtimes are observations, not byte-reproducible outputs.
limits: One sequential run per model on the public synthetic smoke corpus; not the private decision-quality evaluation.
Grounding on ran before off for each model; order and cache warming may affect timings and usage.
Findings count submitted observations, not unique verified defects. Fixed-control flags use the published location-based scorer.
CLI-reported normalized token counts include cache reads and cache creation as input where applicable. Provider tokenizers and system/tool contexts differ; token totals are not cost measurements.
The harness ends after review and automatic stage skips, not a complete docs/lint/test/publish lifecycle.
timing_note: Snapshot timers are unmodified. Suite runtime includes small checkpoint-write overhead between snapshots.
